mapper.select: SELECT C.CODE_GROUP, C.CODE, C.CODE_NAME_MSG_CODE, C.SORT_ORDER, C.EXT_VALUE1, C.EXT_VALUE2, C.EXT_VALUE3 FROM TB_COMMON_CODE C JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE_GROUP G ON G.CODE_GROUP=C.CODE_GROUP AND G.USE_YN='Y' WHERE C.CODE_GROUP=#{group} AND C.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDER,C.CODE
SELECT MENU_ID,PARENT_MENU_ID,MENU_CODE,MENU_NAME_MSG_CODE,MENU_TYPE,SCREEN_ID,FORM_PATH,ICON_NAME,SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER,MENU_ID

SELECT MB.MENU_ID,B.BUTTON_ID,B.BUTTON_CODE,B.BUTTON_NAME_MSG_CODE,MB.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU_BUTTON MB JOIN TB_BUTTON B ON B.BUTTON_ID=MB.BUTTON_ID AND B.USE_YN='Y' WHERE MB.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY MB.MENU_ID,MB.SORT_ORDER,B.BUTTON_ID
